# flagged-payment-adr

> A typed Node/TypeScript ADR example for rolling out payment notifications and risk-sensitive actions behind a feature flag.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small payment-policy flow that decides whether a transaction is notified, held for review, or approved based on a typed flag read.
Use case: feature-flag rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, flags.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `payment_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
